title: 挾尪仔 Ngeh Ang-á
mood: deadpan and smitten at one in the morning
subject: on a one a.m. claw-machine date she wins in one try the duck he fed six hundred dollars to, and hands it to him
caption: Taiwanese Hokkien 80s synth-pop in a retro Taiwanese new-wave style with home-keyboard kitsch. Juno-style analog polysynth pads holding the chords; a DX7-style FM electric piano and bell answering the vocal; a sequenced sixteenth-note synth bass; a LinnDrum-style drum machine with a gated-reverb snare and Simmons-style tom fills; a cheap home-keyboard organ playing the lead riff between lines, with chorus-drenched clean electric guitar on the offbeats. Straight eighths, no swing. A bright, dry and punchy 1980s mix, drum machine and synth bass forward, pads wide. Dry, deadpan male lead with laid-back swagger, the chorus sung in octave-doubled unison. 118 BPM, F major. Deadpan and smitten at one in the morning. No slap bass, no horn section, no jazz chords, no vocoder, no autotune, no modern EDM drop, no synthwave arpeggios.
lyrics:
[Verse]
半暝一點 挾尪仔店 日光燈白鑠鑠
你講你佮意 彼隻掛目鏡的鴨仔
我講 小可代誌 看我的
一百箍 換十个銅板

[Pre-Chorus]
爪仔落去 爪仔挾起來
鴨仔擛擛手 閣跋落去

[Chorus]
挾尪仔 挾尪仔
我的手誠穩 我的心袂定
六百箍 挾無一隻鴨
你佇邊仔 笑甲跍落去

[Verse]
你講換你 你干焦投一擺
爪仔慢慢仔落 慢慢仔挾
規隻鴨 輾落去出口
你共伊囥佇我的手內 講「送你」

[Chorus]
挾尪仔 挾尪仔
我的手誠穩 我的心袂定
六百箍 換你一句「送你」
這隻鴨 我欲共伊縛佇機車頭前

[Bridge]
橐袋仔 猶賰九个銅板
你指隔壁台 講「伊的某 嘛掛目鏡」

[Chorus]
挾尪仔 挾尪仔
我的手誠穩 我的心袂定
九个銅板 我毋甘投落去
明仔暗 換我共你講「送你」

[Outro]
掛目鏡的鴨仔
坐佇機車頭前 看我咧笑
